recognize_zh: 高倍下真皮小血管周圍被小至中型淋巴球緊密環繞並侵入血管壁，血管腔內有紅血球與纖維蛋白樣物質，形成血管中心性（angiocentric）浸潤；細胞核略不規則但異型性不高，這種血管中心性、輕度異型的T/NK細胞浸潤是HV-LPD的特徵之一。
features: Small dermal vessel cuffed and permeated by lymphocytes (angiocentric/angioinvasive pattern)
Vessel lumen containing red cells and pale eosinophilic fibrinoid material
Infiltrating cells are small to medium-sized with round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Only mild cytologic atypia; no large pleomorphic cells evident
Background dermal collagen with interstitial lymphocytes and scattered extravasated red cells
describe_en: High-power examination of the dermis shows a small vessel surrounded and infiltrated by small to medium-sized lymphocytes with slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with red cells and fibrinoid material in the lumen. Lymphocytes also extend interstitially between collagen bundles. Cytologic atypia is mild, and large pleomorphic cells are not identified. The angiocentric infiltrate of mildly atypical lymphocytes, in conjunction with EBER positivity and a cytotoxic phenotype, is consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is also angiocentric and EBER-positive but typically shows more pleomorphic medium-to-large cells with extensive necrosis and occurs outside the photodistributed childhood HV setting.
Vasculitis shows neutrophils with nuclear dust or reactive lymphocytes around vessels that are EBER-negative, without a dense interstitial atypical infiltrate.
LyP contains large CD30-positive atypical cells in a mixed inflammatory background and is EBER-negative.
